subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the following sentence.

I do not have any __access__ to the information in this matter.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Denial**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"access"** means the ability to approach, enter, or use something. (पहुँच)

 
 
• **Example: **She has access to all the latest research materials in the library.
 
 
 
• **"Denial" **refers to the action of declaring something to be untrue or the refusal to grant something. (इन्कार)
 
 
• **Example: **His denial of the allegations surprised everyone in the room.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'access' **is **'denial'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Denial**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Doubt **(संदेह): A feeling of uncertainty or lack of conviction.

 
 
• **Example:** There is some doubt about the accuracy of the report.
 
 
 
• **Reach **(पहुंच): The extent or range of something's application, effect, or influence.
 
 
• **Example: **The reach of the internet is global.
 
 
 
• **Clue **(संकेत): A piece of evidence or information used in the detection of a crime or solving of a mystery.
 
 
• **Example:** The detective found a crucial clue at the crime scene.
